title: 'It Doesn't Matter...': Ex-India Cricketer Offers Key Advice To Abhishek Sharma | Cricket News - News18
text: Former Indian cricketer Harbhajan Singh has said that when someone registers three ducks in a row, a lot of things go on in the player’s mind, adding that Abhishek Sharma should believe in his abilities despite not being able to score a single run in the T20 World Cup. Abhishek entered the final group-stage clash on the back of a demoralising duck against arch-rivals Pakistan in Colombo. On that occasion, he attempted to take on off-spinner Salman Ali Agha after struggling to pierce the off-side infield. A similar pattern played out against the Netherlands, with Abhishek struggling to pierce the offside field and resorting to his trademark slog. But he was beaten by a quicker ball that skidded on, rattling the stumps and cutting short his stay at the crease. “When you go through something like this, a lot of things run through your mind. I have a small message for Abhishek. I would advise him to believe in his abilities and this too shall pass," Harbhajan said while speaking on his YouTube channel. “I am sure that the day his bat speaks, it will speak rightly. We are all waiting and we hope that he comes to form in that big match against South Africa. I would also advise him to leave that midwicket area for a while now and look to play straight," Harbhajan said. “Once he scores 1-2 runs and then he gets some shots out, then he will get his confidence back and also his form. South Africa might also look to bring an off-spinner straightaway, but it doesn’t matter," Harbhajan added. Yet to score a run in the tournament, Abhishek batted for more than an hour in the main square of the sprawling stadium ahead of the Netherlands game but nothing worked in his favour.
